name: Look Again
tagline: The more you like an answer, the harder you look at it.
epigraph: "Gin" began as a short form of the name of the spirit in this glass.
glassware: rocks glass (about 300 ml), filled with ice cubes
language_row: Wren's checks on v3: title block, whoYouAre (cut from 217 to about 170 words) and yours swap-tested against the family (in her turns); lint 0 errors, 2 warnings (gendered pronouns in yours 1–2, historical persons, accepted by Wren in r4). ✓
sources: Studio fact card `_studio/fact-cards/sylvius-morewood-genever.md`. Oxford Companion, primary: SYLVIUS, FRANCISCUS (pdf 1968), GENEVER (pdf 870, 872–875), GIN (pdf 889–890), WHISKY (pdf 2131), COOLHAES (pdf 570), SPIRITS WRITING (pdf 1884). *Imbibe!* pdf 68, 175, 185–187. *Flavor Matrix*, Grain chart (pdf 137, printed 127).
names_note: *Look Again* (3–0, round 4: Wren, Tomás, Hester), over *Too Good to Be True* (Wren's pick until the vote), *The Older Answer* (Hester's pick until the vote), *One More Layer* and *What Came First*. Picks were held until the vote.
open_items: Strength sits on the floor of the built range (27.0%) at the weakest legal oude genever (35%); a 40% Armagnac with a 35% genever goes 0.2 under, and a sugar-free genever 0.05 g under on sugar. Named in Sweeps (Tomás).
The image's "pale gold-amber" colour is Tomás's estimate, unsourced (no genever has to be aged, Oxford pdf 875).
